briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Anthropic Claude 4.5 escalate multi-agent capabilities amid rising compute race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released multiple advanced reasoning models this month as funding surged past $11B. Competition intensifies between US and Chinese developers while safety concerns mount over agentic systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with enhanced multi-agent orchestration; Anthropic released Claude 4.5 featuring improved tool use. DeepSeek v4 closed the gap on Western models with open weights.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: xAI expanded Colossus cluster to 400k H100 equivalents; Google announced new TPU v6 pods for internal training. Microsoft and CoreWeave signed major colocation deals.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models from DeepSeek and Meta overtake closed frontier systems by end of 2027?
